name: MMA-CDR API health and route discovery
expected: Health reports status ok with the active database name; OpenAPI lists real MMA-CDR routes and no stale LocalHub routes.

name: MMA-CDR branded navigation and demo/live mode
expected: The actual five UI tabs render and remain keyboard- and mobile-discoverable.

name: Universal file ingestion and raw staging
expected: Upload responses report the parser and extracted-candidate count defined by api/ingestion.py; invalid parses and oversize files return controlled errors.

name: Python phone normalization, fingerprint and suppression request input
expected: Formatting-equivalent US values share canonical E.164 and fingerprint; only the implemented suppression-hash contract returns SUPPRESS.

name: Actual scoring decision paths and boundaries
expected: Responses contain actual score fields and follow source-code thresholds; REST does not pretend to set duplicate or persisted-DNC flags.

name: Telemetry analysis, persistence and alerts
expected: Analysis values and alert types match api/app.py; valid snapshots are retrievable and persistence failures do not become hidden passing database assertions.

name: Upload-to-persisted decision and VICIdial telemetry-to-dashboard workflows
expected: Actual upload/refine/score/telemetry/dashboard routes are sequenced; local isolated SQLite confirms staged raw records, decision persistence, snapshots and alert persistence.

name: VICIdial WebSocket frame, validation, reconnect and recovery
expected: Valid messages receive raw telemetry and insights; malformed messages receive controlled error frames while the socket/API remains usable.

name: SQLite development fallback persistence and constraints
expected: Only the seven tables currently defined in api/db.py are asserted; this is not represented as SQL Server compatibility.

name: SQL Server DDL source and optional dedicated integration checks
expected: Static DDL checks always run; live integration runs only against an explicitly designated *_test or *_qa database and uses rolled-back transactions.

name: Rust refinery and Python utility contracts
expected: Rust live checks are skipped when no Rust service is configured; provider checks use offline stubs and never call paid services.

name: VICIdial extension telemetry mapping and popup safety
expected: The worker/content contract matches the source, and untrusted alert text is rendered as text rather than HTML.

name: Measured ingestion and concurrency regression
expected: Measured timings are attached without inventing a fixed SLO; controlled parallel requests return expected statuses.

name: Non-destructive security and metadata boundaries
expected: Inputs are validated/handled according to current contracts; wildcard CORS and missing auth are documented risks, not reported as secured features.

name: End-to-end scrub-to-score and VICIdial telemetry workflow
expected: The UI's separate implemented API actions complete and their SQLite side effects are checked when the isolated SQLite service is active.
